# Form Control

A `Form Control` is a generic wrapper for form controls.
See [Input fields guidelines<i className="ds-icon-launch"></i>](https://design-system.airbus.corp/components/input-field/design/)

In addition to a label, it can display an optional state, a help text, and a help link.

See <LinkTo kind="General/Forms/Introduction" story="docs">Forms</LinkTo>

<Source code="import { FormControl } from &#x22;@airbus/components-react&#x22;" />

<Primary />

<Controls />

* Any other props supplied will be provided to the root elements
* For details on CSS styles, see [CSS implementation](https://github.airbus.corp/Airbus/design-system/blob/develop/packages/styles/src/elements/FormControl/index.ts)
